claim: A NAT gateway forwards IP-fragmented packets only for UDP and drops fragmented TCP and ICMP packets; a NAT instance reassembles fragmented packets for UDP, TCP and ICMP.
question: Which NAT option handles fragmented TCP or ICMP packets?

values.display: Supports forwarding of IP fragmented packets for the UDP protocol
Fragmented packets for these protocols will get dropped
Supports reassembly of IP fragmented packets for the UDP, TCP, and ICMP protocols
